For integer n, {R>n}={BZ≥n}; conditional Pareto tail is min(1,(Z/n)^kappa). Source induced stationary density bounded on Y implies P(Z>z)=O(2^-z), finite C_kappa. Layer-cake gives exact deficit and O(2^-n/n). Conditional mixed tails converge to kappa-size-biased Z independent of Pareto overshoot by dominated convergence; tower mass finiteness iff E R<∞ iff kappa>1. Independently checked exact integer returns (Z,B)=(2,2),(3,3),(4,5): R=5,10,21. Source stationary law is NOT asserted uniform and numerical uniform test only diagnostic.
